environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with ALB. Application runs with KEY_PROVIDER=local (HMAC signing with env var secret). ALB configured with default settings, no rate limiting. ECS task runs 4 instances behind the load balancer with sticky sessions disabled. No request deduplication layer. Redis not configured for distributed locking.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB with default config, 4 tasks, no WAF
config.concurrency: multi-instance, no distributed lock, no request dedup
